formulas.effective_task_cost: AI Inference Cost + Tool Cost + Human Review Cost + Expected Rework Cost + Expected Failure Loss
formulas.effective_roi: (Baseline Human Cost - Effective Task Cost) / Baseline Human Cost

assumptions.human_review_cost: review_minutes / 60 x reviewer_hourly_rate (applied to every task)
assumptions.rework_share: fraction of failed tasks fixable by rework; the rest become failure losses (no double counting)
assumptions.break_even_success_probability: p at which Effective Task Cost = Baseline Human Cost (Effective ROI = 0)
